<style id="oh-tt">
/* Equal compact quote tiles — lock to first-pair size; overflow clamps, cards do not grow */
#testimonials-viewport{height:340px!important;min-height:340px!important;max-height:340px!important}
#testimonials-viewport>div[data-slide]>div,#testimonials-viewport .oh-testimonial-grid{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:22px!important;align-items:stretch!important;height:100%!important;max-width:none!important;margin:0!important}
#testimonials-viewport>div[data-slide]>div>article:nth-child(n+2){display:flex!important}
#testimonials-viewport article{position:relative!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;height:320px!important;min-height:320px!important;max-height:320px!important;padding:26px 24px 20px!important;border-radius:18px!important;background:#0b1228!important;background-image:none!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)!important;box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.28)!important;text-align:center!important;overflow:hidden!important;gap:0!important}
#testimonials-viewport article::before{content:""!important;display:block!important;position:absolute!important;left:10%!important;right:10%!important;top:0!important;height:1px!important;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(183,162,252,.9),rgba(139,144,255,.85),transparent)!important;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(139,144,255,.45)!important;opacity:1!important}
#testimonials-viewport article img{display:block!important;width:56px!important;height:56px!important;margin:0 auto 14px!important;border-radius:50%!important;object-fit:cover!important;flex-shrink:0!important}
#testimonials-viewport blockquote{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;width:100%!important;flex:1 1 auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:9.3em!important;overflow:hidden!important;display:-webkit-box!important;-webkit-box-orient:vertical!important;-webkit-line-clamp:6!important;font-size:.92rem!important;line-height:1.55!important;font-style:italic!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86)!important;text-align:center!important;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;quotes:none!important}
#testimonials-viewport blockquote::before,#testimonials-viewport blockquote::after{content:none!important}
#testimonials-viewport article p{position:relative!important;display:block!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;margin:16px auto 0!important;padding:16px 6px 0!important;border:0!important;font-size:.9rem!important;line-height:1.4!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)!important;text-align:center!important;background:transparent!important;flex-shrink:0!important;white-space:nowrap!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important}
#testimonials-viewport article p::before{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;left:6%!important;right:6%!important;top:0!important;height:1px!important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.28) 50%,transparent)!important}
#testimonials-viewport article p::after{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;left:50%!important;top:-1.5px!important;transform:translateX(-50%)!important;width:90px!important;height:4px!important;border-radius:70px!important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#6C72FF 50%,transparent)!important;filter:blur(1.5px)!important}
#testimonials-viewport article p strong{color:#fff!important;font-weight:650!important}
@media(max-width:900px){#testimonials-viewport{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important}#testimonials-viewport>div[data-slide]>div{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;height:auto!important}#testimonials-viewport article{height:auto!important;min-height:280px!important;max-height:none!important}#testimonials-viewport blockquote{max-height:none!important;-webkit-line-clamp:unset!important;display:block!important}}
</style>
<style id="oh-deal-desk">
/*!
 * Dealality Old Home — Problem Deal Desk (Phase A static)
 * Scope: #about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk | .dealality-problem-desk
 * No autoplay animation. data-story-state hooks reserved for Phase B.
 */

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk,
.dealality-problem-desk {
  --dpd-bg: #070b1a;
  --dpd-surface: rgba(14, 22, 48, 0.92);
  --dpd-surface-2: rgba(8, 14, 32, 0.96);
  --dpd-border: rgba(155, 138, 251, 0.16);
  --dpd-border-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --dpd-text: #ffffff;
  --dpd-muted: rgba(183, 196, 255, 0.68);
  --dpd-muted-2: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  --dpd-purple: #9b8afb;
  --dpd-purple-deep: #5b21b6;
  --dpd-blue: #60a5fa;
  --dpd-teal: #2dd4bf;
  --dpd-gold: #d4a574;
  --dpd-radius: 16px;
  --dpd-radius-sm: 10px;
  --dpd-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--dpd-text);
  font-family: "DM Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk *,
.dealality-problem-desk * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-sr-only,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

/* Desk shell — L→R ~1.8:1 on desktop */
#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-desk,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-desk {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 1.15rem 1.1rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--dpd-border);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 12% 18%, rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.18), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 88% 78%, rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.06), transparent 50%),
    linear-gradient(165deg, var(--dpd-surface), var(--dpd-surface-2));
  box-shadow: var(--dpd-shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-flow,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-flow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
  gap: 0.55rem;
  align-items: stretch;
  aspect-ratio: 1.8 / 1;
  min-height: 0;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-zone,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-zone {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: var(--dpd-radius);
  border: 1px solid var(--dpd-border-soft);
  background: rgba(8, 14, 32, 0.55);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-zone-label,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-zone-label {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

/* —— Zone 1: Opportunity —— */
#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-opp,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-opp {
  border-color: rgba(155, 138, 251, 0.28);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(28, 36, 72, 0.95), rgba(12, 18, 40, 0.98));
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), 0 12px 28px rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.12);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-opp-top,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-opp-top {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-hotel,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-hotel {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 64px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(155, 138, 251, 0.3);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.4), rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.45));
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-hotel svg,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-hotel svg {
  width: 42px;
  height: 36px;
  display: block;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-opp-title,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-opp-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--dpd-text);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-opp-meta,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-opp-meta {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: var(--dpd-muted);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-fields,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-fields {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  flex: 1;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-field,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-field {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 0.38rem 0.45rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  background: rgba(8, 14, 32, 0.5);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-field-dot,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-field-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  margin-top: 0.28rem;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: var(--dpd-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(155, 138, 251, 0.14);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-field span,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-field span {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 550;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-connectors,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-connectors {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: -0.4rem;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 0.55rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  overflow: visible;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-connectors svg,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-connectors svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
}

/* —— Zone 2: Workstream lanes —— */
#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lanes,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lanes {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.28rem;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.4rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  background: rgba(10, 16, 36, 0.72);
  flex: 1;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--brand,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--brand {
  border-color: rgba(155, 138, 251, 0.32);
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--dpd-purple);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--operator,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--operator {
  border-color: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.28);
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--dpd-blue);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--advisor,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--advisor {
  border-color: rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.28);
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--dpd-teal);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--capital,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--capital {
  border-color: rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.32);
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--dpd-gold);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane-h,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane-h {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-avatar,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-avatar {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(155, 138, 251, 0.35);
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(155, 138, 251, 0.35), rgba(20, 28, 60, 0.9));
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--operator .dpd-avatar,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--operator .dpd-avatar {
  border-color: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.4);
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.35), rgba(20, 28, 60, 0.9));
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--advisor .dpd-avatar,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--advisor .dpd-avatar {
  border-color: rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.4);
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.3), rgba(20, 28, 60, 0.9));
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--capital .dpd-avatar,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane--capital .dpd-avatar {
  border-color: rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.45);
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.32), rgba(20, 28, 60, 0.9));
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-avatar svg,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-avatar svg {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane-name,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-lane-name {
  margin: 0;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-arts,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-arts {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.28rem;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  min-height: 0;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.18rem;
  padding: 0.32rem 0.35rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  background: rgba(8, 14, 32, 0.75);
  min-height: 2.6rem;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art-label,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art-label {
  margin: 0;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  font-weight: 550;
  line-height: 1.2;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--email,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--email {
  border-color: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.28);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.28), rgba(8, 14, 32, 0.85));
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--pdf,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--pdf {
  border-color: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.28);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--deck,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--deck {

}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--sheet,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--sheet {
  border-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.25);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--note,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--note {
  border-color: rgba(253, 224, 71, 0.22);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(253, 224, 71, 0.08), rgba(8, 14, 32, 0.85));
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--call,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--call {
  border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.28);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--term,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--term {
  border-color: rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.35);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--follow,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art--follow {
  border-style: dashed;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art-viz,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-art-viz {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 1.1rem;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-bar,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-bar {

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-bar--wide,

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-pdf-page,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-pdf-page {

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-pdf-badge,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-pdf-badge {

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-deck,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-deck {
  height: 1.35rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(196, 181, 253, 0.28);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.4), rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.3));

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-deck i,

.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-deck i:nth-child(2) { height: 65%; }
#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-deck i:nth-child(3),
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-deck i:nth-child(3) { height: 50%; }

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-grid,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 2px;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-cell,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-cell {
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 1px;
  background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.18);
  border: 1px solid rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.22);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-cell--warn,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-cell--warn {
  background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.22);
  border-color: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.35);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-cell--empty,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-cell--empty {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-wave,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-wave {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 1.1rem;
}
